text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Just as being dragged around by Sasami Anshinzawa
as a guinea pig for her sasabari acupuncture
had become my everyday normal, one day――

text_block_list.name: Sasami Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text:
...Hey! Listen to this,
<username>!

text_block_list.name: Sasami Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text:
Guess what! I won a hot spring trip ticket in the lottery!
Must be because of all my good daily karma~ ♪
choice_data_list: It must be your good daily karma... Well, congratulations.

text_block_list.name: Sasami Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text:
Geez, slow on the uptake, aren't you?
You're coming along with me now, you know?

text_block_list.name: Sasami Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text:
I won a vacation voucher for a pair!
And when it comes to my pair, it's gotta be you, right~?

text_block_list.name: Sasami Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text: And with that, let's hit the hot spriiiings♪

text_block_list.name: Sasami Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text: Whoa☆ What a gorgeous ryokan~♪ I'm gonna brag all about this to Master when I get back!
choice_data_list: Are you sure you're okay with this?

text_block_list.name: Sasami Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text:
Naturally!
After all, you always help me out with practice~♪

text_block_list.name: Sasami Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text:
A-Ah, it's not like you're the only person I could invite
or anything!
Don't go thinking I'm some loner with no friends, okay?!

text_block_list.name: Sasami Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text: Mmm~♪

text_block_list.name: Sasami Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text:
Phew…… That feels so good♪
Hot springs are just sooo relaxing~☆

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: After taking a bath—on my way back to the hall, I bumped right into Sasami Anshinzawa.

text_block_list.name: Sasami Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text:
Oh my!
Did you just finish up too?

text_block_list.name: Sasami Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text:
A healing effect that easily rivals sasabari acupuncture……
Hot springs truly are amazing~♪

text_block_list.name: Sasami Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text:
Oh, wanna check out the souvenir shop?
You'll want to buy something for your trainee too, right!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Afterward, one thing led to another, and I ended up
buying matching regional acupressure needle keychains with her...

text_block_list.name: Sasami Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text:
Haaah... This is the absolute best!
I just wanna lounge around here forever~♪
choice_data_list: I can't possibly let you do that...

text_block_list.name: Sasami Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text:
Jeez, I know already~!
I've got an important mission to carry out, after all!

text_block_list.name: Sasami Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text:
I poke Umamusume with my bamboo needles to help 'em out
and deliver peace of mi~nd――

text_block_list.name: Sasami Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text:
Thanks to you hanging out with me,
my Sasabari needle skills have improved a lot,
so I've gotta keep working even harder from now on♪
choice_data_list: Let's keep up that momentum and raise our success rate!

text_block_list.name: Sasami Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text: Yes! With a partner like you by my side, I can become bigger and better than ever!

text_block_list.name: Sasami Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text:
...I know!
Since we're at it, why don't the two of us just go overseas together?

text_block_list.name: Sasami Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text:
I'm gonna spread the wonder of bamboo needles across the entire globe!
My little sister knows all about foreign affairs, so I'm sure she'll be thrilled to support me♪

text_block_list.name: Sasami Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text:
And then, and then!
Eventually—
choice_data_list: ...I'm sorry, but I have to support her.
...I'm sorry, but I have to support her.

text_block_list.name: Sasami Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text:
Oh come on! No way, did you actually take me seriously?!
Of course I was just kidding~♪

text_block_list.name: Sasami Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text:
I have no intention of getting in the way
of you and your Umamusume! Truly!

text_block_list.name: Sasami Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text:
Well, but I'm TRULY grateful♪
Master even said I could move on to my next training... instead of just serving tea!

text_block_list.name: Sasami Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text:
I do the Sasabari, you do the support...
Now that's the absolute most re-aaasurring way to go ☆

text_block_list.name: Sasami Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text:
Alrighty!
After loosening up in the hot springs, nothing beats bamboo needles♪

text_block_list.name: Sasami Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text:
I prepared a special needle just for today!
Take it right to the point☆

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I saw it coming,
but it really had to turn out like this, huh...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: And yet, I can't help but feel this is just who we are.

text_block_list.name: Sasami Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text: Here it goes, jab-a-roo!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Bullseye needle poke, massive success!

text_block_list.name: Sasami Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text:
Heheh, amazing, right~?
I practiced tons and tons just for today! ☆

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (THUD!!)

text_block_list.name: Sasami Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text:
Wait, huh—!?
Even though it was a huge success, whyyy!?

text_block_list.name: Sasami Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text: Did it work a little too well~? Hellooo? Can you hear me~?

text_block_list.name: Sasami Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text:
...Aargh, seriously!
Next time, I'm gonna nail it for sure!

text_block_list.name: Sasami Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text: I'm gonna hit you with something so incredible, you'll completely regret turning down my invite ☆

text_block_list.name: Sasami Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text: That's why—you have to support <chrname>-chan with everything you've got, okay? Understood?!

text_block_list.name: Sasami Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text:
It was a precious moment where I felt
an irreplaceable bond with Sasami Anshinzawa...
choice_data_list: (Wait, aren't you the last person who should be saying that??)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
As my consciousness faded away,
that silent comeback crossed my mind.
